description: This file defines the implementation of a FastbootProxy class that manages fastboot command interactions within the Cuttlefish project. It includes methods for creating commands, checking if the proxy is enabled, and setting up dependencies. It also provides a component registration function for dependency injection.

classes.name: FastbootProxy
classes.description: A class that provides fastboot command proxying functionality, including command generation, enabling logic, and dependency management within the Cuttlefish environment.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates a list of monitor commands to start the fastboot proxy tunnel.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the proxy, 'FastbootProxy'.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Determines if the fastboot proxy should be enabled based on configuration and boot flow.

methods.name: Dependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies required for setup, specifically the log pipe provider.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Performs setup actions, such as obtaining the kernel log pipe.
